messages:
alex: Heads up — planning to cut the release candidate in ~45m (cut window at 15:15 PT). Need final eyes/approvals on a few PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5423 (backport for jwt fix), https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5431 (changelog entry), https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5440 (runtime perf tweak). Can someone take a look? Tagging @maria @ryan for backports. Thanks!
maria: Taking a look at #5423 now. If tests pass I'll approve and open the backport PR.
ryan: I'll review #5440 in ~10m. Heads-up: the perf change touches kernel selection — will sanity-check latency numbers.
ci-bot: Check queued: linux-unit (5423) — running, integration (5431) — flaky on shard-3, smoke (5440) — passed.
sophia: For changelog, can you paste the one-liner you want in the release notes? I can add it to CHANGELOG.md and push.
alex: Changelog short: 'Improve runtime kernel selection to reduce tail latency for short sequences.' Full note in draft: Optimize kernel heuristics to prefer quantized fast paths for seq_len <= 128; falls back to precision kernels for long sequences.
luis: FYI I can't approve PRs touching infra without infra lead; @sophia could you add the 'infra-approved' label? Or we can use canary fallback.
maria: Approved #5423 — merging after CI. Backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5452
jenkins-bot: Merge queue: #5423 passed, merged by maria. #5440 blocked by lint failure: see snippet.
```diff
- magic_kernel.select(...)
+ magic_kernel.choose(...)
```
ryan: Fixing lint now, pushing patch in a minute.
qa-bot: Can we hold the cut 10m if integration tests keep failing? Integration flakiness might trigger rollback and cause churn.
alex: Let's proceed — cut as scheduled unless integration regressions occur. If integration fails, we rollback and re-run tests. Please ping here once you merged and opened backports. :thumbsup: 
sophia: Changelog updated and labeled. Adding infra-approved. #5431 now approved.
luis: Backports queued and tagged. Thanks all.
ryan: Pushed lint fix, CI re-run started: https://ci.internal/12345/status
ci-bot: All green for #5440 now. Ready for merge.
alex: Merging now. Cut will proceed. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
